name: @untch/trust-bureau
description: Untch Bureau (PRD §12) — deterministic, weighted, NO-LLM (I1) vendor + buyer reliability scoring with per-score uncertainty and enforcement via the lower-confidence bound (LCB = score − z·σ). Four vendor features are computed from real receipt/escalation/on-chain history; three (rating_quality, price_sanity, claims_consistency) are honest cold-start-prior-only stubs (marketplace data unavailable — see README finding), renormalized out with σ widened per §12's fallback rule. Buyer hygiene is fully real. Epoch snapshots are merkle-rooted and anchored on-chain via UntchReceipts.anchorScore (§10.3 ScoreAnchored). Anti-gaming and appeal flow are explicitly deferred, not silently absent.
